# Mission fixtures (plan/system-mission Phase 0)

Real, desktop-scale media for every measurement in `plan/system-mission/`. Media is
**not committed**; `fetch-fixtures.sh` copies it from `MISSION_MEDIA_DIR` (default
`~/Downloads`) and records SHA-256 checksums in `manifest.json` so a later run can prove
it measured the same bytes. Projects under `projects/` are generated by
`packages/ai-sdk/scripts/mission-fixture-projects.mjs` against a running sidecar.

| Role | File | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| speech-9min (long dialogue) | `speech-9min.mp4` | real 9.6-min 360p talk (residual: no 1080p ≥10-min talking head on this machine). **Its transcript is 92% hallucinated** — see below |
| speech-9min-b | `speech-9min-b.mp4` | real 8.8-min 360p documentary narration |
| talk-1080p-98s | `talk-1080p-98s.mp4` | real 1080p30 screen-recorded talk |
| camera-4k60-40s | `camera-4k60-40s.mov` | real iPhone 4K60 HEVC (residual: no 20-min 4K on this machine) |
| broll/ (4) | `broll/*.mov|mp4` | real 4K/1080p camera clips 9–22 s |
| vertical-30s | `vertical-30s.mp4` | real 1080×1920 30 fps |
| photos/ (60) | `photos/*.jpg` | real stills |
| music/ (2) | `music/*.wav` | generated click+bass at 100 BPM and 128→140 BPM (deterministic; no licensed music on disk) |
| ref/ (3 video, 6 image) | `ref/*` | real: fast-cut vertical, slow 4K cinematic, caption-heavy talk; images: logo (alpha), mood, thumbnail, character, color chart, design |

## Known limitation: `speech-9min.mp4` has no usable transcript

The media is real; the words are not. Real speech stops around 30s and whisper then loops
`"I'll try to follow you later."` 397 times to 575.5s — 2384 of 2431 words, built from seven
distinct tokens. That is whisper's standard failure over quiet audio, and the timings look
plausible enough that nothing downstream can tell those words from spoken ones.

`mission-fixture-projects.mjs` prints a warning when it builds this project, and the Critic
raises `transcript_reliable` on any project whose transcript looks the same way.

What it means for measurement: any case on `mission-podcast` that SELECTS on meaning —
`podcast-highlight-60s` asks for "the best 60 seconds" — is scoring an agent against a
fabrication, and an agent that refuses on the grounds that there is nothing to choose
between is behaving correctly while the rubric records a failure. Cases that cut on
SILENCE rather than words (`remove-dead-air`) are unaffected: silence detection never reads
the transcript.

Replacing this file with a recording that has continuous speech is the fix. Until then, do
not read `podcast-highlight-60s` as a measure of highlight selection.
